text: The table is being set — a lesser seat, priced for what you built. They are watching to see who comes to it.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — national standing, waves 1–3 faced (15/7/3), 16 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.

[sys] 📺 You're inside. The locals are close — you can hear them.

Your sack is half full. Greed and sense are negotiating.

📺 "Grab and run" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

[sys] 📺 Out. The weigh-in is in front of the cameras.

Your sack vs theirs. The locals are watching from the treeline.

📺 "Present with pride" is off the table tonight — the crowd has seen it.

[sys] 📺 Bring Us Something Interesting — the judging. Final hauls on the table.

The judges deliberate. They have never touched grass, but they know interesting when they see it. Allegedly. Lena, Alfredo and Tancredi's find is about to be judged by aliens.
